item.title: The Psychology of Digital Reading
item.description: What keeps readers engaged online isn't magic - it's neuroscience, design, and a few carefully applied psychological principles. There's a cruel irony at the heart of digital writing: we have more readers than ever, yet holding their attention has never been harder. The average webpage visit lasts under a minute. Most articles are never finished. And yet — some content gets read all the way through, shared, remembered, acted upon.
